id: AT-GR-03 gsd path guard, drive-form git toplevel (MSYS)
note: The GSD path guard of measure <handoff> under MSYS or Cygwin perl (Git Bash), where Git for Windows prints the toplevel in drive form (C:/...). The guard joined that toplevel to the cwd, so every STATE.md read as outside this worktree. The worktree, and a gsd path in drive form, are now read in their /c/ form (util::root_form) before the compare. Seams: STORE_TEST_OS=msys, STORE_TEST_CYGDRIVE (C: reads as $TMP/cyg/c), and a git first on PATH that prints $TMP/cyg/c/... as C:/... A nested checkout's STATE.md is still not read. On macOS and Linux a drive path keeps its old reading.

setup.script:
out=$(PATH=${PATH#*:} git "$@"); rc=$?
[ -n "$out" ] && printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed 's#^.*/cyg/c/#C:/#'
exit $rc
